title: Collab: concurrent first-creation of an undefined structural container (asClasses) loses one peer's contents (root-key LWW)
description:
FIXED (task 1360). Root cause: optional structural root containers (asClasses, classpaths, publishProfiles, flaSwfBlobs) start undefined on createDocument(); the binding created them lazily via root.set(key, new Y.Map()/Y.Array()) on first use. That is a root-MAP-KEY set, resolved by Yjs LAST-WRITER-WINS at the key level, so two peers FIRST-creating the same absent container concurrently each mint their own container and the loser's whole container (the class it just added) is silently discarded. Reproduced (scratch, removed, tree clean): A adds Foo.as / B adds Bar.as concurrently -> both converge to [Bar.as] only.

FIX (packages/collab/src/schema.ts): eager deterministic genesis + presence sentinel. materializeDoc now eagerly creates every optional root container at genesis (ensureOptionalMap/ensureOptionalArray) even when the model field is undefined, and the container is NEVER deleted (deleting the key would re-open the race on a later re-add). With the key present from the first synced state, a subsequent first-add is a sub-key write on a shared container (container.set(path,..)/yarr.insert) which MERGES, not a root-key LWW. Round-trip identity (absent must rebuild as absent, not spurious []) is preserved by an idempotent boolean presence sentinel: Y.Map containers carry an internal __present key; Y.Array containers carry a sibling scalar root key <key>__present (an index-0 marker would NOT be idempotent — two concurrent index-0 inserts both land/double; a scalar boolean is idempotent same-value LWW). The <key>__present companion keys are treated as structural so the atomic reader never leaks them. Coordinated with validateInboundDoc (1350: operates on the clean rebuilt model, stays identity) + the 1359 __order reconcile (orthogonal; untouched).

VERIFY: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build green. pnpm --filter @flash/collab test --run = 39/39 pass, incl the P0 7,200-step property test (exercises removeAsClass -> asClasses:[]), 1350 validate (17), 1351 json hardening, 1359 convergence (8), 1348 perf. ADDED convergence.test.ts 'concurrent FIRST-creation of an absent root container (task 1360)': (1) two peers each first-create asClasses (Foo.as / Bar.as) -> BOTH survive on both peers; (2) same for classpaths (other absent root container); (3) absent asClasses round-trips as ABSENT despite eager pre-creation. authoring-ui suite 1157/1157 pass. docs/37-collab.md updated (new §1360 section + mapping-table notes).
